goal.text: Stay safe when the ground shakes.

intro.text: The ground is shaking! What will you do?

hint.text: Find something strong to hide under.

lesson.text: When the ground shakes: Duck, Cover, and Hold! Stay put until the shaking stops.

choices.label: Run outside
choices.heading: Not safe yet
choices.feedback: Stay inside while it shakes. When it stops, walk out with your teacher.

choices.label: Duck under the desk
choices.feedback: Duck under your desk. Hold on to it. Stay there until the shaking stops.

choices.label: Go to the window
choices.feedback: Window glass can break. Stay away from windows.

choices.label: Stand by the tall cabinet
choices.feedback: Cabinets and shelves can fall. Stay away from heavy things.
